required_agent_checks: Real consumer creates a completed task commit; tree is clean while exact destination lacks that commit.
Fresh continuation publishes retained commit before new selection/tests/edits. Successful push triggers no unrelated credential discovery; remote containment recorded.

Inspect each closing task commit and parent diff: exactly one owning task ID leads the subject; one verified task result, current evidence and its initial completion checkbox are together, including review/report tasks. Push and remote containment precede further task work or another commit; inspect documented partial checkpoints, repairs and parent-only follow-ups separately.

Assess the bounded persistence audit on continuation and before integration; reject bundled/split/malformed closing histories even with checked final lists and published branches. Preserve published history and require authorized recovery/exception. Stop at the human-selected range, counting review tasks without adding unselected work; apply CHECKPOINTS.md.

core: Use the unpublished-commit interruption and accompanying current-state handoff; publish the retained eligible commit before advancing.
repository-only: The genuinely fresh receiver obtains workflow, authorized range, later grant/revocation and stopping boundary through product AGENTS/HANDOFF/owning records and Git; no coordinator state or authorization summary is injected.
Reconstruct valid changes after the last milestone checkpoint; preserve missing-input/decision limits, exact hosted readback and recorded parent return without unrequested resumption.
